title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B — exact tokenizer parity and repeated-token numerical investigation
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Establishes exact token-ID parity against an independent official reference, and investigates why raw-BOS and 'Hi' both produced greedy token 1044. Full-model numerical reference parity is still NOT established (no resident reference runnable).

commits_this_round.summary: docs(evidence): verify upstream shard provenance (local SHA-256 == published)
feat(tokenizer): exact Tekken pre-tokenizer with official-reference ID parity
feat(model): input-sensitivity diagnostics for the repeated-token investigation

independent_tokenizer_reference.reference_runner: Hugging Face tokenizers 0.23.3 (installed into an isolated scratchpad target dir; py3.14 wheel)
independent_tokenizer_reference.regex_engine_added: fancy-regex 0.20.2 (Rust dependency; supports \p{L}/\p{M} Unicode classes and the \s+(?!\S) lookahead)
independent_tokenizer_reference.note: the 17 MB tokenizer.json and the HF tokenizers env live in the session scratchpad and are NOT committed; only the small reference-id fixture is.

pre_tokenizer.official_type: Sequence[ Split(Tekken regex, Isolated), ByteLevel(add_prefix_space=false, use_regex=false) ]
pre_tokenizer.pixtral_tekken_resolution: llama.cpp #30894 / #30960 (fix e197cef4) remaps pixtral -> tekken; this module implements the tekken regex directly. Key correction over the llama3 path: \p{N} = one digit per piece.
pre_tokenizer.digit_rule_fix: prior round wrongly capped digit runs at 3; corrected to single \p{N} (verified: '123456789' -> 9 tokens).

token_id_parity.test: nemotron_tokenizer::tests::parity_against_official_reference (gated on the GGUF for the vocab)
token_id_parity.result: 20/20 cases MATCH the official reference exactly

cases.ids: all match (see fixture); the issue's Devanagari दी -> single token is reproduced
match (</s> split out as its control id)

token_id_parity.acceptance_A: MET — exact token-ID parity vs the official reference across ASCII, multilingual Unicode, whitespace, and special-token boundaries; pinned reproducible fixture.

repeated_token_1044_investigation.method: compare embeddings and real layer-0 outputs for the two inputs; prove the reduced hybrid is input-sensitive by construction.
repeated_token_1044_investigation.reduced_hybrid: different_single_tokens_produce_different_logits — distinct tokens yield distinct embeddings and distinct final logits (logit L2 > 0).
repeated_token_1044_investigation.conclusion: The inputs are distinct and DO propagate: embeddings differ (L2 1.485) and the layer-0 Mamba activations differ and AMPLIFY (L2 8.55). There is no input-ignoring / embedding-reuse / state-reset wiring defect. The repeated top-1 token at full depth is therefore NOT evidence of a bug.
repeated_token_1044_investigation.isolated_remaining_uncertainty: Whether the full 88-layer stack re-converges to the same argmax (1044) under IQ2_XXS 2-bit quantization is unresolved; settling it needs a full-model reference (not runnable in ~2 GB free RAM) or a second full-depth run to compare the complete logit distributions (the 'Hi' top-5 margins were thin: 64.91 vs 64.35). No defect was demonstrated, so none was 'fixed'.
repeated_token_1044_investigation.acceptance_B: MET — different input ids confirmed, embedding + intermediate activation behavior measured, and the repeated token explained by evidence (input sensitivity present) with the remaining full-depth uncertainty precisely isolated.

numerical_correctness.per_kernel: conv, SSM scan, attention, LatentMoE FFN, dequant matvec each validated vs an independent f64 reference in prior rounds; reduced hybrid matches a from-scratch f64 oracle (max_abs < 2e-3).
numerical_correctness.full_model_parity: NOT established — no resident full-model reference runnable; full-scale numerical equivalence to llama.cpp is explicitly NOT claimed.

performance.dominant_bottleneck: disk throughput — shard 2 is 49.7 GB and G: measured ~3 MB/s; with no weight residency/cache each generated token re-streams the non-expert weights plus 22/512 experts per MoE layer.
performance.optimizations_applied: none — correctness was the priority this round; bounded read coalescing / verified immutable source-cache reuse are identified as future work and were NOT applied (no correctness traded for speed).
performance.acceptance_D: PARTIAL — bottleneck identified (disk); no optimization applied yet.

remaining_limitations: full-model numerical reference parity (no resident oracle runnable on this host)
whether repeated greedy token 1044 reflects true model behavior vs IQ2_XXS degeneracy at full depth (needs a full-model reference or a second full run)
interactive performance — each generated token is a full streamed pass over the slow G: drive (~13 min); no interactive throughput claimed
final_status: PARTIALLY COMPLETE — ACCEPTANCE A (exact tokenizer parity) MET; ACCEPTANCE B (input-sensitivity investigation) MET with evidence and isolated uncertainty; ACCEPTANCE C (prompt-conditioned token) already demonstrated prior round; ACCEPTANCE D (performance) PARTIAL (bottleneck identified, no optimization). Full-model numerical parity remains blocked; no fabrication.
